# 16 Historical & Regional Peace Treaties Library (v13.5).

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Westphalian Sovereignty & Cuius Regio (1648 Peace of Westphalia)
# ==============================================================================
oe_pt_westphalian_sovereignty = {
	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 35
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 8
	antagonism_type = antagonism_peace_treaty_demands

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		OR = {
			scope:winner.religion != scope:loser.religion
			scope:winner = { oe_pt_in_europe = yes }
			scope:loser = { oe_pt_in_europe = yes }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_pt_westphalia_loser_mod }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_pt_apply_westphalian_sovereignty = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:winner.religion != scope:loser.religion }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_PT_AI_DIFFERENT_RELIGION"
				value = 15
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Nerchinsk Border & Frontier Trade Accord (1689 Sino-Russian Treaty)
# ==============================================================================
oe_pt_nerchinsk_border_trade = {
	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 25
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 4
	antagonism_type = antagonism_trade_wars

	potential = {
		scope:winner = { country_rank_level >= 3 }
		scope:loser = { country_rank_level >= 3 }
		OR = {
			scope:winner = { is_neighbor_of = scope:loser }
			AND = {
				scope:winner = { oe_pt_in_eurasia = yes }
				scope:loser = { oe_pt_in_eurasia = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_pt_nerchinsk_loser_mod }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_pt_apply_nerchinsk_border_trade = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:winner = { is_neighbor_of = scope:loser } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_PT_AI_BORDER_NEIGHBOR"
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

# 4. Mare Liberum Forced Maritime Opening (1609 Grotius Doctrine)
# ==============================================================================
oe_pt_mare_liberum_opening = {
	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 30
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 8
	antagonism_type = antagonism_maritime_aggression

	potential = {
		scope:winner = { num_of_ports >= 3 }
		scope:loser = {
			num_of_ports >= 3
			OR = {
				navy_size >= 15
				has_markets = yes
				country_economical_base >= 40
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:loser = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_pt_mare_liberum_loser_mod }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_pt_apply_mare_liberum_opening = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:loser = { has_markets = yes } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_PT_AI_COMMERCIAL_RIVAL"
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

	blocks_full_annexation = yes
	category = country

	cost = {

			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 25
		}
	}

	base_antagonism = 5
	antagonism_type = antagonism_looting

	potential = {
		scope:loser = { oe_pt_has_plunderable_art = yes }
	}

	allow = {
		scope:winner = { exists = capital }
		scope:loser = { oe_pt_has_plunderable_art = yes }
	}

	effect = {
		oe_pt_apply_restitute_masterpieces = yes
	}

	ai_desire = {
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE"
			value = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:loser = {
					any_work_of_art_in_country = {
						art_is_priceless = no
						origin ?= { owner ?= scope:winner }
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_PT_RESTITUTE_OWN_ORIGIN"
				value = 35
			}
		}
	}
}
